newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Blast damages Israel army hitchhiking post.
newsitem.headline: Blast damages Israel army hitchhiking post.

text.p: An Israeli soldiers' hitchhiking post was damaged in a West Bank explosion apparently caused by Palestinian guerrillas early on Sunday but no one was injured, military sources said.
They said the explosive device blew up near the Alon Shvut Jewish settlement in the Bethlehem area south of Jerusalem. Israeli army reinforcements were rushed in and began a search of the area.
